functions.name: mbrtowc
functions.notes: C mbrtowc with a static state: C-locale byte path by default, strict UTF-8 path when the locale gate is enabled, persisting the exact continuation-range accumulator.

validation.comparison: All 256 one-byte inputs in both locale modes, 110 two-byte boundary combinations, accepted/rejected three- and four-byte forms and every prefix, null/zero cases and split resumes compare return, state word, output word, stack pointer and a SHA-1 digest of complete memory.
limitations: Out-of-bounds s/pwc/ps pointers and oversized counts are not exercised.
The shipped locale gate defaults to the C branch; UTF-8 is dormant unless enabled.
Ledger: 242 server bodies recovered and 492 remain machine code.
